dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington polygon boundaries and extensive codes for wetlands identified as environmentally significant.

Purpose: The datalayer was derived from a working (maintenance) copy of the Sensitive Areas Ordinance GIS data set WETLDSAO. As of October 1997, the content of the two coverages is the same. This datalayer is the recommended data source for wetlands which pertain to development regulation, and is suitable for reference, medium to small scale map displays, and generalized analyses.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
